latest_user_requirement: One unified framework with three candidate mechanisms inspired by human visual behavior and classical algorithmic ideas, with explicit task assumptions, conditional theoretical support and causal evidence in six cross-domain experimental settings; classical plug-in names are not innovations.

working_research_target_not_user_supplie.why: Use a concrete substantial-gain target rather than counting a fractional improvement as the entire requested goal. This is an aspirational research target, never a guaranteed outcome or a reason to suppress negatives.

module_acceptance: Each retained module has an interpretable conditional/interaction contribution in relevant strata and proper same-input ablations; no demand for every module to be positive on every direction.
quantity_controls: Separate count correction from ranking and report both; do not reject a real count benefit simply because it is not a ranking benefit.
ordinary_baseline: Same frozen candidate/frontend and information, same actual question budget; sufficient head training; final/mean/hard and direct teacher-fill controls; do not weaken it.
goal_completion: Do not complete on execution PASS, only C1/C4, or sub-point improvements; if six-direction target unmet continue evidence-guided research and retain failure records.
evidence_limits: All data development; no guarantee of a positive result; KITTI four videos only; actual new method cost must be measured before final deployment claims.
terminology: Six cross-domain experimental settings; historical direction keys and C1..C6 IDs retained for file compatibility.
theoretical_acceptance: Specify the task-specific mechanism and its assumptions before claiming a theorem; prove only the property of the implemented subproblem. Do not claim conditional surrogate-risk/coverage/stability results imply HOTA improvement, biological fidelity, global convergence, or universal superiority to fair ordinary distillation.
theory_status: Proposed design and derivations documented; current registered recipes continue unchanged as component evidence, not validation of the new unified energy.
